blocks.heading: Trusted by teams who sweat the details
Selected work
blocks.introduction: A few projects we are proud of, chosen because the hard part was invisible by the end.

blocks.text: Good motion is not decoration. It is the interface explaining itself: where things came from, where they went, and what just happened because you touched it.

items.title: Product design
items.summary: Research, flows and interfaces for web and native apps, designed in the browser as early as we can.

items.title: Motion systems
items.summary: A shared language of easing, timing and choreography, so every transition in your product feels like the same hand made it.

items.title: Brand & identity
items.summary: Marks, type and colour that hold up at 16 pixels and on a billboard, and know how to move.

items.title: Front-end build
items.summary: We ship what we design: fast, accessible sites and component libraries your team can keep building on.

steps.title: Listen
steps.description: A week of calls, product walkthroughs and support tickets, until we can say what is actually wrong.

steps.title: Frame
steps.description: One page that names the problem, the constraints and what done looks like. Everyone signs it.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.description: Clickable, animated, ugly where it does not matter yet. We test it with real people in week three.

steps.title: Refine
steps.description: Type, colour, motion and copy tightened until nothing is left to explain.

steps.title: Ship
steps.description: Production code or a handover your engineers enjoy reading, and two weeks of us on call.

blocks.quote: Paraline found the three seconds of our onboarding that were losing people, and made them the part everyone screenshots.
blocks.name: Amara Okafor

blocks.heading: Have something that should feel better?
blocks.body: Tell us about it. We reply within two working days, usually with questions.
